title: test_instance_address holds on Windows: its off-box tooth asks about ~/.cairn, and relpaths compare as posix
intention: test_instance_address measures the address rungs on every box: its off-box tooth reds only a resolver that reaches the real ~/.cairn, and its relpath teeth compare in one spelling.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 by akiendell on Windows (read-only, house checkout and a worktree): test_instance_address.py reds at :84 'instance resolved to C:\Users\akien\AppData\Local\Temp\tmp...\state\devices\chart\0, which contains the real home directory'. Path.home() is C:\Users\akien and tempfile.gettempdir() is under it, so 'home not in str(path)' fires on every honoured scratch path. Re-measured on akienyoga9i via bin/cairn test: past that tooth, test_component_dirs (:225) and the homes tooth (:237) compare str(relative_to) against '/'-joined literals, and Windows gives '\'.
traces_to: Law 3; Law 8 (a red tooth over a right resolver is a false red, and gets distrusted).
how: D1 the off-box tooth asks 'under the real ~/.cairn' and 'under the given roots'. D2 relpaths compare via as_posix().

clauses.claim: the off-box tooth reds naming the real ~/.cairn when instance_path ignores its roots, and is green when it honours them, on Windows and Linux
the component_dirs and homes teeth are green on Windows

decisions.text: D1: test_the_three_rungs_resolve_off_this_box asserts each path is not relative to Path.home()/.cairn and is relative to its temp roots.
D2: the relpath sorts at :225 and :237 use Path.as_posix().

measured.what: test_instance_address.py on Windows at house HEAD
measured.saw: red at :84, 'contains the real home directory' on a temp path
measured.how: akiendell, read-only run, relayed by akienasus and the orchestrator

measured.saw: 1 green; hollow (instance_path roots=None) red naming C:\Users\akien\.cairn\devices\chart\0; str(relative_to) at :225 red with backslash relpaths
